methods.skew: pandas adjusted Fisher-Pearson sample skewness; descriptive only
methods.spearman: average-tie ranks then Pearson; no SciPy dependency
methods.mode: binary categorical indicator; Pearson with continuous features is point-biserial interpretation

excluded_from_continuous_regression.key: pitch class/circular category; numeric labels are not a linear scale
excluded_from_continuous_regression.time_signature: categorical meter, not continuous weather evidence

methods.zero_one_unit_interval_tail_ratios: <=.01 and>=.99 ratios apply only to declared0..1 continuous features
methods.source_tempo_zero_values: 157 unique source records have tempo0; retained in source descriptive cohort and excluded from eligible base; do not interpret0 as a measured slow BPM

collinearity.mode_coding: 0/1 categorical indicator, standardized as a single design column; not an ordinal music scale
0/1 categorical indicator, standardized as a single design column; not an ordinal music scale

review_flags.interpretation: Statistical rarity for human/domain review, not errors; no automatic deletion or imputation
review_flags.mad_zero_handling: Do not divide by0; no robust-z flags; report nonmedian count separately
review_flags.iqr_zero_handling: No IQR flags if IQR0; report zero-IQR status
review_flags.genre_exception_note: Global fences can flag normal genre-specific characteristics; inspect genre-level context before any change
review_flags.many_flags_note: Zero-inflated instrumentalness/speechiness and long-tailed liveness/duration can create many valid review flags; flags are not evidence of corruption

weather_score_correlations.source: Imported without modification from V2 summary calculated over the same base61931; core-passing representative rules

limitations: No weather-suitability or listening-rating y exists
Feature-to-feature auxiliary least squares is redundancy diagnostics, not weather regression fitting
No weather suitability, causality or population preference is inferred
Genre labels are multiple memberships; ratios can sum above100percent
Original genre rows were balanced at1000per label and are not market prevalence
No production changes or external/LLM API calls
